relations.zotero_refs:
[RCJ46BHM]: 329 records lineage of Madhyamaka from Nāropa (ID:5639) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895): Nāgārjuna (ID:3720), Āryadeva (ID:3702), Candrakīrti (ID:3725), Mātaṅgi (ID:8412), Tailo (ID:5641), Nāro (ID:5639), Mar pa (ID:6968), Mi  la (ID:8405), Dwags po (ID:4189), Dus gsum mkhyen pa (ID:3855), 'Gro mgon Ras chen (ID:8421), sPom brag pa (ID:8427), Karma pa Pakṣi (ID:8417), Auḍyāyana pa (ID:7346), Rang byung rdo rje (ID:3897), g.Yung ston rdo rje dpal (ID:8418), Rol pa'i rdo rje (ID:7397), mKha' spyod dbang po (ID:3901), De bzhin gshegs pa (ID:6785), Ratnabhadra (ID:6927), mThong ba don ldan (ID:6159), 'Jam dpal bzang po (ID:8428) and/or dPal 'byor don grub (ID:8420), Chos grags rgya mtsho (ID:8419), sNye bo/'og Go shri (ID:8430), rJe btsun Ras pa chen po (ID:8429), Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895). 

[RCJ46BHM]: 337 also records the lineage of Madhyamaka from Jo bo Dīpaṃkara (ID:3745) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895): Nāga (ID:3720), Āryadeva (ID:3702), Candrakīrti (ID:3725), Rig pa'i khu byug che (*Vidyākokila) (ID:7788), (Rig pa'i khu byug) chung (i.e. a wa d+hu ti) (ID:7963), Jo bo Atisha (ID:3745), sTon pa chen po (i.e., 'Brom ston rGyal ba'i 'byung gnas) (ID:3827), sPyan snga ba (Tshul khrims 'bar) (ID:3830), Bya yul pa (ID:3915). Then from many unspecified bKa’ gdams pa masters to Lord sGam po pa (ID:4189). 

Alternatively, from Bo to ba (i.e. Po to ba) (ID:3829), Sha ra ba (ID:3869), to Dus gsum mkhyen pa (ID:3855), and from him it is then the same as the first lineage of Nāropa (ID:5639) according to Mi bskyod rdo rje (ID:6895) (see [RCJ46BHM]: 329).
